story.text: We run about forty head of Angus-cross cattle on rotated pasture. Calves are born here in spring and stay on this ground until they leave for the processor, twenty minutes up the road.

claims.words: 100% grass-fed and grass-finished. Hay from our own fields in winter.
No antibiotics. A sick animal gets treated and is sold separately.
Born and raised on this farm in Butler County.
